name: 参考樱花 01

parameters.prompt: One complete cherry blossom tree, matching the supplied isolated tree image. Reconstruct the ENTIRE DENSE FLOWERING CROWN as textured 3D blossom clusters connected to natural branching limbs. Preserve this reference tree silhouette, branch structure and flower color. Full detailed back and sides, realistic natural fine flower sprays suitable for a miniature Japanese town. Flowers must be abundant, not bare branches, not smooth spherical blobs. Bark visible on the lower trunk. Root flare meets ground at one point. No black background surface, no ground plate, grass, pedestal, sky, text, shadows baked into textures, or detached floating petals. Curving S-shaped dark trunk, asymmetric pale pink broad canopy with an airy gently windswept left side.

imageProvider: User supplied sheet; deterministic crop and square padding, no image regeneration

inspection.notes: 曲干、偏侧舒展树冠；花簇为块面近似。
inspection.limitation: Generated blossom clusters approximate the photographic fine flowers; not individual petals.

curation.reason: 花冠有明显的大片折纸状面片，细节不足。
